reviews.review: one of the greatest games ever, made my an amazing development team who dont seem to understand the restrictions placed by budget. 10/10 game

Decent 7/10, add or subtract 1 based on how many close friends are playing the game too.

Main points:
1) Excellent monetization model that rewards smart people. 
This is the big thing that everyone talks about, since you can earn what you want without intrusive lootboxes. This is the true "sense of pride and accomplishment" here.

2) Grind grind grind. 
Sometimes I fall asleep while holding W, but I still think it's worth it in the end.

3) Shallow storyline if you could call it one. 
Depending on the person you ask, it could be an amazing campaign that brings tears to the eye, but for me it devolves into villains talking menacingly while I half-heartedly pay attention and over-dramatic/edgy cutscenes with no substance. Naruto did it better (if you needed a frame of reference, no pun intended).

4) Minimal hand-holding.
If you're tired of super invasive tutorials (like ones that pause the game and show you pictures), then this should be a refresher. However, it's a double-edged sword because this game lacks the clever game/level design that almost always complements the lack of hand-holding. You will eventually go to Google if you keep playing, despite the few learning resources already in the game.

5) Fantastic support of the game.
This is the other reason the game is as popular as it is. There is a ton of content, and the next major update is tons of hype too!

Other points:
-Defense mode will most definitely halve your framerate due to the sheer number of enemies. Please consider a framerate cap.
-Mobility feels good for quickly moving towards your destination but feels restrictive during combat.
-The level # for missions (e.g. Level 23) does not mean that you get a decent challenge with the same level gear. You actually would be putting yourself at a disadvantage without appropriate mods to your weapons and warframe.
-When people say "the community is great" they are referring to the individuals that left a massive impact. Other than that, people still can get annoyed/frustrated with each other or leave games if they feel like it. That's just the nature of being in random squads in any game.

------
I think all of this sums up to 7/10. What do you think?
